author: SickProdigy
description: A nostalgic catching RPG with activity encounters, battles, progression, retro scenes, a modular interactive Pokedex, Kanto Gyms, and persistent badges.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, globally owned Pokemon, party selections, inventory counts, persistent Pokemon health/status, badges, healing-item counts, catch provenance, Pokedex and trainer-card display preferences, active battles, restart-safe trade journals, and guild/channel spawn and Pokemon Center configuration. User deletion removes the requesting user’s collection and active encounters, cancels pending trade offers, and preserves any already-completed transfer.
install_msg: Configure an opt-in channel with `[p]pokemonset channel #channel`, then choose a starter with `[p]pokemon starter bulbasaur`. This is an unofficial noncommercial game.
name: Pokemon
short: Global Pokemon catching and wild battles
